items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: There’s also a beautiful concert hall where Benjamin Britten used to go and give his premier performances north of London called Maltings.

ctx.x: And this particular recording, I’m interested in. Was that the only live recording done of that particular chart first of all?

No. There is a new recording that’s coming out on CD, it was live at Ronny Scott’s, it was Buddy Rich’s 50th birthday, and they’re re-issuing that. There’s also a beautiful concert hall where Benjamin Britten used to go and give his premier performances north of London called Maltings. Maltings on the Snapes. It’s like a swamp area, a bog—
